reply_text:
I found no 2024 prediction in Legg's own words on a page I could open. What I did find are two news reports of his talk at SXSW in March 2024, where he kept his long-standing view that there is a 50-50 chance of AGI (AI that can do the thinking tasks people can) by 2028.

- **Semafor:** Reed Albergotti, who interviewed him on stage, wrote that Legg told me he came to believe in 2001 that we would have a 50/50 chance of reaching AGI by 2028. He says that number is still about right. This is the reporter's summary, not Legg's own words.
- **AI Business:** reported that he stood by his prior prediction that there is a 50-50 probability AGI will come by 2028, and that while AGI may come "soon," the full range of practical uses is "decades away." Only those two short phrases are quoted from Legg.

**Leads I couldn't confirm:**
- **Two posts on X from 2024.** The site blocked page openings, so I didn't use them. One is a reply dated about 13 December 2024 that reads "I've been predicting a 50% chance of AGI by 2028 for 20 years." The other is from about November 2024 and says AI and AGI will be "deeply transformative" for science "in the coming decades." I saw both only in search snippets. They are the best leads to check by hand.
- **The How I Built This podcast (11 April 2024).** The episode page had only a description and the transcript page would not open.
- **His 6 May 2024 talk at USI's Dies academicus.** I found the event but ran out of page openings before I could read it.

**A dating mistake to watch for:** LessWrong's "2024 in AI predictions" lists his line "I think there's a 50% chance that we have AGI by 2028" as a 2024 prediction. It actually comes from the Dwarkesh Podcast in October 2023.

I used 9 of 12 searches and all 6 page openings. Three of the openings failed: both X posts and the Player.fm transcript page.
